meta.name: Terriers 720p
meta.description:
Ex-cop and recovering alcoholic Hank Dolworth partners with his best friend, former criminal Britt Pollack, in an unlicensed private investigation business. The series is set in Ocean Beach, San Diego, California, although it is portrayed as a distinct town, with Dolworth having once been a member of the fictional Ocean Beach Police Department.

Complete series. On your server: S1 13/13

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: A favor for an old drinking buddy leads Hank and Britt, down a rabbit-hole of corruption in deceptively sunny Ocean Beach.

videos.title: Dog and Pony
videos.overview: Desperate for quick cash, Hank and Britt set out to capture escaped convict Mongo for a big reward.

videos.title: Change Partners
videos.overview: In order to secure a loan, Hank must prove that the bank manager's wife is cheating on him. But what he discovers is much kinkier than infidelity.

videos.title: Fustercluck
videos.overview: Robert Lindus is back with an unusual request from jail: he wants Hank and Britt to steal a quarter of a million dollars from him.

videos.title: Manifest Destiny
videos.overview: Hank and Britt deal with the widening scope of the Lindus conspiracy as they try to avoid the rap for a murder they (technically) didn't commit.

videos.title: Ring-a-Ding-Ding
videos.overview: Hank and Britt go on a wild goose chase through Ocean Beach while searching for an engagement ring.

videos.title: Missing Persons
videos.overview: Hank and Britt help an amnesiac college student with the case of his missing identity.

videos.title: Agua Caliente
videos.overview: Hank and Britt both work with their ex-partners to make it out of some hot water south of the border.

videos.title: Pimp Daddy
videos.overview: While Hank recovers from his injury, Britt teams up with a transvestite hooker to solve the death of her friend.

videos.title: Asunder
videos.overview: Fighting the urge to drink on Gretchen's wedding day, Hank stumbles back onto the radar of the conspiracy threatening Ocean Beach.

videos.title: Sins of the Past
videos.overview: Hank gets a second shot at the rape case that got him ejected from the police department in a mystery spanning multiple time periods.

videos.title: Quid Pro Quo
videos.overview: Hank, Britt, and new ally, Laura Ross, unravel the Ocean Beach conspiracy, which puts them and everyone they love in immediate danger.

videos.title: Hail Mary
videos.overview: Hank runs out of options and time and Britt faces a decision that will change his future.

meta.slogan: They'll solve anything for the right price.
